description: Source code for the PointCoordinates class in the libqhullcpp library, managing a vector of points with various constructors, methods for appending points, validation, and output streaming.

classes.name: PointCoordinates
classes.description: A class representing a vector of point coordinates with methods for construction, validation, appending points, and output.

methods.name: checkValid
methods.description: Validates that the internal coordinate data matches the expected data and count.

methods.name: setDimension
methods.description: Sets the dimension of the points, throws error if invalid or incompatible with current dimension.

methods.name: beginCoordinates
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of coordinates for a given point index.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends coordinates from an array, another PointCoordinates object, or a QhullPoint.

methods.name: appendComment
methods.description: Adds a comment string to describe the points, with validation.

methods.name: appendPoints
methods.description: Reads point data from an input stream, parsing dimension, count, and coordinates.

methods.name: indexOffset
methods.description: Calculates the starting index in the coordinate vector for a given point index.
